But the brief undercuts that. The coin is down 62% over 30 minutes and 78% from its 30-minute high, which is a collapse rather than a consolidation. Last 15 minutes show 45.18 SOL sold against 47.74 SOL bought, so the net flow is nearly flat and sellers are almost as numerous as buyers. The sell-to-buy ratio of 1.14 in the first two minutes after graduation and the launch bot presence point to early distribution. Pool depth is only 52.8 SOL, so our $20 ticket would face meaningful impact and our round trip would cost the high end of the fee range. Nothing here shows demand that will persist for the next 30 to 60 minutes; it shows a coin that has already bled and is still being sold into.

Verdict: no honest case for a buy. Skip.
